Database State

Privacy

DBMS
The Database System Environment The DBMS is an important component of the database environment.

client-server application

Definitions and Functions Data

______ is a collection of logical constructs used to represent the database's data structure as well as the data relationship(s) found within that structure.
database model
A database model is a collection of logical constructs used to represent the database's data structure as well as the data relationship(s) found within that structure.
______ refer to an external schema, and are mapped by the DBMS to the internal schema for execution.
Programs

STORM model
A STORM model is a directed, acyclic graph(DAG) consisting of several topic nodes (T-nodes).
